newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-SPANISH LEAGUE TO BREAK FOR TWO WEEKS OVER NEW YEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPANISH LEAGUE TO BREAK FOR TWO WEEKS OVER NEW YEAR.

text.p: The Spanish league will break for two weeks over the New Year after the players' union accepted the clubs' proposal to move games originally scheduled for December 29 to February 19.
Some players had talked of strike action to restore their traditional Christmas holiday but the agreement means there will be no professional football in Spain between December 23 and January 4.
